_comment: Small scan for smoke tests: verifies the label plumbing (materials and objects -> class
ids -> .las) on a stock Blender, without the patched build. It uses the panorama camera,
which ignores the scan pattern and samples equirectangularly, so the geometry of the cloud
is wrong for training -- use scanner_mobile_mapping.json for real data.
The CPU backend is not an option here: it builds a BVH per object and cannot read
compute_device is NONE (Cycles on the CPU) on purpose: a Blender built with
WITH_CYCLES_CUDA_BINARIES=OFF compiles its CUDA kernels at runtime with nvcc, which
refuses host compilers newer than GCC 15. Build with CUDA binaries on for real runs.
